_readme: Reviewed ADR ratios for the fundamentals build only (EPS, dividend and share count restated per US security: scripts/build-fundamentals.mjs via api/_lib/adrResolve.js, and the market cap in ticker-meta.json). ratio = home-market shares per ONE US-listed security. An entry fills in where api/_data/fpi.json documents no ratio; force: true wins over fpi.json (a programme that ended). Kept apart from config/adr-overrides.json on purpose: an entry there also routes every Form 4 line of the ticker through the foreign-issuer normaliser. Always cite the source.

AZN.source: AstraZeneca ended its ADS programme on 2026-01-30; the ordinary shares list directly on the NYSE under AZN from 2026-02-02 (press release 2026-01-20). fpi.json still holds the retired F-6 ratio of 0.5.

INDV.source: Indivior terminated its ADR programme in June 2023; ADSs were mandatorily exchanged 1:1 for ordinary shares, which trade on Nasdaq as INDV (now a 10-Q filer). fpi.json holds the 2014 F-6 ratio of 5.

SMMT.source: Summit Therapeutics redomiciled to Delaware in 2020 and its ADSs became common stock; it files 10-Q/10-K. fpi.json holds the 2020 20-F ratio of 5.

ZLAB.source: Zai Lab 10-K: each ADS represents 10 ordinary shares (since the 2022 share-structure change); fpi.json reads 1.

(config/adr-overrides.json keeps CX's Form 4 rule, which is about CPOs.)
